conviction_note: The cause is complete, dated and fully public since 04:30 ET: an FDA recommendation to run a survival trial before a BLA. The primary document is two paragraphs and the tape has had a whole session to read it. Leerink's defence note was already out this morning. I found no dated in-window catalyst either way; the one open supply channel is an effective, never-drawn Leerink/Cantor ATM that a company funded into 2028 has little reason to use at roughly 1.3x cash. So the number is that small ATM risk and nothing more, and it deliberately sits above the cross-section prior of -0.87 because I could not source a second shoe.

cause.label: litigation_or_regulatory
cause.what_happened: At 04:30 ET on 2026-09-22 (8-K accepted 08:30:16 UTC) Compass said the FDA recommended a trial showing a survival benefit before a BLA for tovecimig in previously treated biliary tract cancer. COMPANION-002 missed OS, which the company attributes to crossover. Shares were down about 38-40% pre-market and printed $1.255 at 09:35 ET. The baseline shows the whole -30.8% as gap with a 0.0% intraday leg to the 15:05 screen, on 8.45x volume.

Press release: FDA recommended a trial demonstrating survival benefit before BLA submission; OS confounded by crossover, not significant; ORR 18.0% vs 5.3%, mPFS 4.7 vs 2.6 months, HR 0.44
Shares traded at $1.255 at publication, 76.55% down year to date

findings.finding: An effective shelf (S-3 filed 2025-12-30, EFFECT 2026-01-07) carries an at-the-market agreement with Leerink Partners and Cantor Fitzgerald. It had sold no shares through H1 2026 and could be drawn from the 2026-09-23 open.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM needs no new filing or pricing event, so sales can begin the moment the next session opens. That puts it inside the window rather than later. Offsetting that: the issuer has never drawn this agreement, and it guides cash of $179.9M (June 30) as funding it into 2028, so the need is low at roughly 1.3x cash per share.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None observable: the 10-Q reports no sales under the December 2025 agreement in H1 2026, and ATM sales are disclosed only in the next periodic report. The August 2025 financing (424B5 2025-08-12/13, with pre-funded warrants) was an underwritten deal, not ATM supply.
findings.why_not_priced: Today's price reflects the FDA news, not the chance of issuer supply from tomorrow's open. If the market fully expected ATM selling, the intraday leg would show the stock bleeding lower. It did not: the stock recovered from about -38/-40% pre-market to a flat -31% on 8.45x volume. I sized this small because the incentive to sell stock near cash value is weak.
findings.independence: Effective registration confirmed separately by the EFFECT notice https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1738021/999999999526000102/xslEFFECTX01/primary_doc.xml and the S-3 with its ATM language https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1738021/000119312525337063/d26360ds3.htm. Both come from the same issuer, so neither is independent evidence that a draw will happen.

outside_window.finding: Cash floor: $179.9M cash and marketable securities at 2026-06-30, no debt, against about 186.8M shares including 6.71M pre-funded warrants, which is about $0.96/share before Q3 burn. At $1.26 the stock trades near 1.3x cash. Real support over weeks, but no mechanism closes any gap by the next close.
Compass says it will 'work with the Agency' toward its planned BLA and will present the full COMPANION-002 dataset at a medical conference in 2026. No date is given for either.
Summit ivonescimab FDA decision 2026-11-14, which Leerink cites as the precedent for filing a BLA over an FDA request for more studies. A positive read-through, a month outside the window.
Q3 10-Q (Zacks-estimated 2026-11-04, a cadence prior and not an announced date) will disclose any ATM sales and any post-setback restructuring or runway revision.
CTX-8371 Phase 1 primary completion 2026-12 per ClinicalTrials.gov. The pipeline value left after tovecimig's setback rests on this, beyond the window.

baseline_tension: The high 14-day ATR (12.3%) and the 8.45x volume both lean toward continuation, and my research sources no second shoe. The flat intraday leg after a pre-market low near -40% and the near-cash valuation cut the other way but carry no in-window mechanism. So I kept the number at the small ATM finding (-0.3), which is less negative than both the own-history mean (-1.12) and the cross-section prior (-0.87), rather than adding the baseline drift, which is common to every name in the day.
